title: Baseline v0.4 lifecycle requirements
description: Convert the approved Requirements and Lifecycle Graph direction into normative v0.4 specifications, an MVP vertical slice, acceptance criteria, and staged implementation tasks.
decision_notes: v0.4 extends ArchMap through installable plugins and does not replace the v0.3 architecture model.
Core owns generic extension/registry/query foundations; @archmap/lifecycle owns lifecycle schema, relations, validators, and views.
The first vertical slice is Requirement -> AcceptanceCriterion -> Architecture Node -> Test -> Evidence.
The first implementation types are Requirement, AcceptanceCriterion, Decision, Risk, Test, Evidence, and LifecycleRelation.
Release/readiness, full project management, WorkLens integration, and GraphPatch are follow-on work after the core model stabilizes.
verification: MVP acceptance criteria AC-01 through AC-12
